title: Horror game my son prompted, but was too scared to play
author: Brave-History-6502
selftext:
This is a super simple prototype.

It uses this cloud game tool I've been working on.

The funny aspect of this is he was too scared to play it since he's only 8. Apparently 8 year kids all have mythology about horror games that they talk about at school but I don't think any of them have played games like this. He was adamant that this is what he wanted though so I indulged out of curiousity.

Workflow is unity, tripo for assets, some open source assets, elevenlabs for audio and the custom harness the studio tool uses which is basically just a bunch of subagents with some tools/jobs.

Overall it took 3 iterations over about an hour and cost about $8 in api/generation fees so that is where I'm really working on improving things for this tool.

replies.author: Brave-History-6502
replies.body: haha thanks. It scared me as well
